======================================================
WELCOME
This is a comprehensive Level 1 to Uber Endgame min/max variant guide.
(NEW INTRO NOTE:) IF you are inexperienced in POE mechanics, and are not willing to "deep dive" the content to learn this build, you will not enjoy this build.  
IF you are new or casual, I take special care to make the progression VERY clear and obvious.
IF you are a veteran, the endgame version of this archetype is going to push the limits, and you will enjoy how it works. 
I respond to all relevant comments on YT and am active in our Discord.  We also have some other GOATed Gurus in the Discord @arq @cur$e and @i9314.  Give your thanks to these goats.

Please post questions in the Spark channel in Discord.  TYTY  GL!  <3
======================================================
Updates (09/06)
All filters are updated.  Bring questions to discord.
Added a brand new and quite distinct variant: Ward-Stacking.  Pob.in link and new video are out: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HX22EJg8d-4 This variant is NOT recoup based and is not a "swap" or scale into.  It is likely 0.5-specific as the ward mechanics will get reworked, nerfed, removed in future patches.
Published FINAL variant with Pob.IN link.  Video explaining this variant with showcase is here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXwE-UgijAI
Created a video going over FAQ and all tips/tricks to help with progression and early mapping: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y223-XVeHUE&t=747s
If you are new here, don't skip the big video that explains this relatively complex build: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=awVaapidjwA&t=382s
======================================================
Explanation of Primary End Game Mechanic
The main thing GGG targeted in caster nerfs for 0.5 is RESOURCE REPLENISHMENT.  We caster bros have rushed to find more hacks at this, and GGG continues to slough off new findings.  One methodology that should not get nerfed (because it is so core to ) is the node .
Pyro Pact removes our mana (completely), and gives us infinite resources (literally).  It also inverts how resources get used (rather than going from full to empty, they go from empty to full and reset).  When your "mana" (called Infernal Flame) gets full, you take ALL OF YOUR HEALTH and ES as damage to yourself (sounds bad, right?).
Believe it or not, this build inverts this downside into an upside with recoup.  We stack life/energy shield recoup, slot in , and become nearly invincible while also completely removing the downside from  and giving ourselves essentially infinite mana.
The mechanic is so powerful, and we invert the downside so dramatically, that we actually WANT to take the damage downside MORE frequently.  So anywhere we can actually reduce our mana pool and increase the cost of spells turns into a GOOD thing.
Also, because our recoup becomes routinely 4000+ life/ES replenishment per second, in the early/cheaper endgame variant we can stack infinite  + , giving us limitless spell damage over the course of an instance.  In the later/$$$$ endgame variant, we drop Demon Form and stack crit with  and a set of low life techs related to , , and .  The final form pulls off the traditional delete-any-boss-in-seconds mode without any pre-conditions.

What's Unique in this Variant?
The main "tech" in this variant is slotting infusion and charge generation in the  link-up, providing consistent infusions for  and  via new league-based mechanics.  You will need to convert you gloves and/or boots to WARD, and run  in your chest.
The second tech is to change your  link-up to  and .  This min-maxes map clear comprehensiveness and also travel speed.  You can also smash Amanamu Abyss mobs with the Culling Strike effect of .  These mobs are otherwise too dangerous because they have mods that disable recovery entirely.  
_____________________________________________
A note on , and how you should use it
1.  Main thing you need is "line of Olroth" which will convert any keystone into .  This disables INT-based mana gain, roughly halving your Infernal Flame, allowing you to generate 2x recoup.  
2.  The second thing to look out for is the "seed #" of your jewel.  Each seed number converts the passives and notables in RANGE of the jewel to NEW and unique passives and notables.  Some of them are CRAZY powerful conversions.

3.  if you combine the range of the jewel (and the passives from the Seed #) with a  that is either  or  allocating, you can get unethical value for just a few passive points.

** WE have a channel in Discord where we log "good" seeds.  There is no way to search seeds in POE2.  Come to this channel to pin down the seed you want and then set up a trade search.

VARIANT: 1-14 (Act 1)

If you are newer to  and its supporting interactions (like , Infusions, , , etc), you SHOULD NOT use Spark in the campaign.  
Find an ED/Contagion league start build, then swap over in mapping to this archetype.

Even though we are Witch, I do not lean hard into the /  staple.  This is because it does not transition well to our mapping variant (on gems and tree), and also a day 1 run does not want to spend gold respeccing and acquiring more gems on the exchange. 
If you are rerolling to this build from something else, you probably have gold and plenty of good items; feel free to find your favorite ED/Contagion creator and follow that guide for campaign and maps.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
General Clear
Outside of bossing, your general clear is simply to let a hoarde of mobs gather together, cast one , and then shoot some  to kill the Contagious monster, the rest will die.

Your other gear is just best-in-slot you can find.  Look for

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
I snapshotted this POB shortly after completing T15 map progression.  If done correctly, this variant clears T15 maps comfortably; can sustain about 50-75  stacks; and can take down powerful map bosses (4-5 Million HP) in about 10 seconds.  If not done correctly, none oft his will happen.  :(

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
TIPS
A huge misconception is how to generate  energy.  Read the gem.  Read it.  It matters how much damage you do when you crit (MORE than how often you crit).  So 80% crit with no crit bonus is worse than 50% crit with lots of bonus.
Sustaining  in this variant took only about 80% recoup on life (no direct recoup on ES; it is dropped from the tree).  But, when 50+ stacks comes, have to rinse and repeat.  You are still strong outside of Demon Form, and then you are a moon eater within it.
Anywhere you can, you want to reduce mana, increase cost of skills, nuke your mana efficiency, and elevate your cast speed and your skill gem levels (which makes them cost more).  All of this allows you to fill your infernal flame faster, and generate more recoup.

When you start a map, spam  until your recoup procs are fully regenerating your health/es globes.  Then activate , and keep it up for the rest of the map simply by spamming  and .
If any point you notice the Demon Form is causing your life to deplete, switch back to  spam (you likely will have to do this as the boss is spawning).
